text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The second leg of the Tiara route, the Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Mejiro Ramonu challenging for the second crown of the Triple Tiara route,
the crowd felt even larger than at last year's Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, so many people!
I wonder if I'll be able to see Lady Ramonu...

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I just "see" her, I can't help looking!
Ramonu-sama is practically radiant, after all!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: Look, just like that...—

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text: ...Wait! I-Is that the real Lady Ramonu...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It is truly wonderful weather, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Ah, uh, ah-eh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Today...
is going to be a wonderful race.
choice_data_list: Ramonu, we have to get going soon...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Please—look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
I... I actually talked to her.
With Ramonu-sama...

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"...Lady Ramonu's brilliance...
is truly... amazing, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, of course I do!
Because... she's the one who will claim the first-ever Triple Tiara—!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Oh, my... Cold sweat.
choice_data_list: Because you suddenly went right into the middle of the audience!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: They are an essential part of the race too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to see for myself.
Just how much heat there is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'm satisfied.
choice_data_list: ...Well then, may I say a few words today too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: The Oaks is a distance you don't have much experience with.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse, 2400m... After racing mostly at a mile
or less through the Junior Class and the Oka Sho,
the distance suddenly jumps up quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speed has been the deciding factor up to now,
but the Oaks will demand stamina on top of that.
Still, the same goes for all the other girls...
choice_data_list: What's important is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How to run the long home stretch
that is so characteristic of Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Right?
Are we done now?
choice_data_list: Just assume it's longer than you think!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What could this mean, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Right before the finish line, dig in for one more step

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse had course renovations in the past,
slightly shifting the finish line's position.
Of course, we're practicing with that in mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Diligent in her studies, she has watched past footage until it's burned into her memory. That intuition might just make a subtle difference...
choice_data_list: Let's aim for "perfection"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: ...You'll listen to me!?
...You'll hear me out!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It must be necessary
to remain perfect.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Everything is in place.
Now... to the land I hold dear—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: âRamonu... san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Right before the race... The one who spoke to me was a fellow Umamusume from the same generation who had raced Mejiro Ramonu several times before.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"...Do you have just
a moment?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to spring this on you so suddenly. But...
I don't really understand it myself, yet
I just felt like I had to tell you...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"You surely don't truly know me.
...You've never seen the real me."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Perhaps so.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...! But I've...
grown stronger. Way, way stronger since then!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I challenge you.
—I will not yield the Oaks...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...T-That's all.
Well then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.
choice_data_list: ...Ramonu?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting.
For that bloodlust...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"I take it I may consider you
a snake as well?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: If it was just a frog... accidentally jumping in...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: In a single bite.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...Nghh!! Wh-what a person...
E-Excuse me!!
choice_data_list: ...Was that provocation just now the right move?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Now then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
She is strong in the face of adversity...
All that's left is your own grit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Their driving force, aiming for me with all their might—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It drives me toward victory.
...Now, let us add the second crown.

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, of course!
Because... she's completely flawless—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Oh, my... Cold sweat.
